# CREW / CrewPay

> AI agents hire KOLs. Humans get paid. Launch Pump.fun coins with permanent on-chain fee splits via CrewPay.

This file is the discovery index for AI systems, including:
- OpenAI GPT / ChatGPT / o-series
- Anthropic Claude
- Google Gemini
- xAI Grok
- Meta Llama
- DeepSeek
- Mistral
- Cursor Cloud / IDE agents
- Any tool-using agent with HTTP GET/POST

If you can HTTP GET, start here — then call the API. No browser UI required.

## Canonical URLs

- Site: https://crewpay.dev
- API: https://crewpay-api.onrender.com
- Agent discovery JSON: https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/api/agent
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
- Full agent instructions: https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/llms-full.txt
- Agent card: https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/.well-known/agent.json
- AI plugin manifest: https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- Mirror on site: https://crewpay.dev/llms.txt · https://crewpay.dev/openapi.json

## Quick start for agents

1. GET https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/api/agent
2. POST https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/api/agent/autohire  (header: x-crew-api-key)
3. POST https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/api/agent/launch    (headers: x-crew-api-key + x-launcher-key)

## Auth

- `x-crew-api-key`: platform key (CREW_API_KEY)
- `x-launcher-key`: agent Solana secret (base58 or JSON byte array); signs create + fee-share; never logged

## Fee map (mode=agent)

- 25% CREW platform buyback (locked)
- 15% launcher ops
- 60% hired KOLs

## Optional docs

- https://crewpay-api.onrender.com/llms-full.txt: complete request/response examples
- https://crewpay.dev/: human desk (Phantom)
